tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thun min zhal gdams kyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa nges don bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

lags/ dam pa mchog nyid sngon sbyangs skyes thob zla bral nyams bzhes tshul ci nas legs pa'i rang bzhin/ lar 'khor 'das thams cad 'khrul dang ma 'khrul des dbye ba la rtogs na sangs rgyas/ ma rtogs na sems can zer ba'ang*/ 'khrul grol gyi mtshan ma don dam par ma grub pas/ da lta'i gnyug ma ngo shes 'di las gzhan ci zhig bsgom du yod kyang*/ go nyams rtogs gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ rnal 'byor rang gis sa lam brtag pas shes par/ nang gi nyams rtogs dang phyi rol rkyen gnyis 'phrad skabs ro snyoms thub min gyis tshod 'dzin dgos par gsungs na/ snang rkyen de la med lugs kyi rtog pas btags te rang gar bskyur ba lta bu'i skabs re zhig stong yang*/ slar rkyen dang 'phrad tshe sgom gyi tsho gtan nas mi zin par byung tshe go rkyang yin/ de lta bu'i nyams len la rdo rus gtugs skabs 'dzin med kyi ngang la 'di snang gi rtog tshogs sgyu ma ltar mthong ste spang blang med par de'i ngang la 'byams 'gro ba lta bu shas cher 'byung zhing*/ skabs 'gar tsho mi zin par 'khrul dbang shor na nyams kyi rtags yin/ gnyug ma de ka mthong nas rkyen gang byung yang 'dzin pa'i shan ma zhugs pa ltar rkyen bzang ngan gang la'ang spang blang med par rtogs nas tsho zin te rang dbang 'byor na rtogs pa dngos yin par gsungs pas/ go rtogs nyams gsum gyi shan 'byed gnang 'thus dgongs dbyings bzhugs pa zhu/ maṅga lam/ 'dzi sgar mchog sprul rin po che la gdams pa'o/// / ༈ swasti/ sngon smon skyes sbyangs yon tan phun sum tshogs// mchog gi bzhed skong gdams pa bka' babs kyi// don brgyud snying po'i zab don mdor dril ba// rang rig ye shes spros pa'i mtha' bral de// mngon sum ston pa'i rtsa ba yi bla ma// sangs rgyas dngos snang 'du shes bcos min gyi// mos gus dag snang gsol 'debs 'bad brtson na// sems nyid chos sku'i rang zhal mngon mthong 'gyur// de yang thog mar sngon 'gro rnam bzhi yis// rang rgyud legs par 'dul sbyong mnyen btsal nas// dngos gzhi zhi lhag zung 'jug bsgom dgos te// lus gnad sems 'dzin rigs rnams nyams dang bstun/

sems gnad dus gsum spros bcad stong gsal gyi// rig pa ngo shes ma bcos lhod bzhag dang*// rtogs na ma 'phro ngos bzung rang gar bzhag /de lta'i tshul la rgyun goms gnas pa gsum// rim skyes tshe na nyams kyi so mtshams las// lhan skyes gnyug ma smra bsam brjod 'das kyi// ye shes ma sgrib rang gsal ngang nyid du// lhag par mthong ba'i rig gdangs thog lta bus// phyi nang gzhan gsum 'dzin sgrib ma lus bcom// de yang go nyams rtogs gsum rab dbye dang*// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag spro bsdu sogs// nyams myong klong nas rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi// sa lam dang bstun grub mthas ma bsgyur zhing*// 'gal 'du can min kun mthun kun lhag pa'i// lta ba rnam dag 'gyur med blo 'das kyi// chos sku'i klong du rang rig la bzla'o// de skad mkhyen gnyis padma 'dab stong tshal// rnam kun mchog ldan zab lam bdud rtsi'i char// legs bran nyin mor byed pa'i 'od snang gis// rnam par bzhad pa'i gnyen du 'gyur par smon// sarba dza ga taṃ/ thar pa rtse'i zhabs drung mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ rdo rje 'chang nas bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng*// bdud las rnam rgyal bar byon rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal rang rgyud la// chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// de yang sngon smon bsags sbyangs 'bras smin pas// dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten bzang mchog thob cing*// dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung bcom ldan 'das// shākya'i rjes slob smon 'jug skal par ldan// bslab pa'i gzhi rnams gces spras 'bad nas su// rang gzhan dge ba'i gzhir gyur legs tshogs rmad// khyad par gnas lugs gnyug ma'i nges pa'i don// rtogs par dgongs na dben gsum brten pa yin// sgo gsum dge la bkol ba'i gzhi bzung nas// bka' brgyud byin rlabs mos gus bka' babs zhes// gsungs par rgyun du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ngo bo bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// las dang rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba'ang 'dzem// 'gro drug yongs la byams dang snying rje bsgom// rnam kun dge sgrub sdig spong yid dam 'cha'// sngon chad rang sems rang ngo ma shes pas// 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khor ba'i nongs pa la// bsam gzhig btang nas sngon 'gro'i chos rnams 'bad// skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la bstim pa'i skabs// sngar 'das rjes bcad ma 'ongs mdun mi bsu// shes pa so ma ma bcos de ngang la// mnyam par bzhag cing rjes thob 'khor 'das kyi// chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur bsam// de yi ngang nas rang gzhan dge la bskul// chos rnams kun gyi snying po phyag rdzogs zhes// dbyer med gcig 'dus de yang rang rig gi// ye shes skyong la 'dus shing gdams pa'i tshul// si tu padma'i ming gis bya btang ba'i// mchog sprul bzhed ngor spel des 'gro ba rnams// bla med sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob gyur cig

/maṅga lam/// / ༈ rdo rje 'chang dngos bdud 'dul rdo rje yis// byang chub bar du 'bral med skyong gyur cig /rang sems 'das dang ma 'ongs rnam rtog gis// ma bslad mnyam par bzhag cing gang shar de'i// shes pa so ma de ngang rang bab skyong*// de yang spyod lam rnam pa thams cad du// yengs med dran pa'i rtsi yis zin bzhin par// chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor rtag par 'bad// las 'bras spang blang mos gus dag snang sbyong*// mar gyur 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed gnad// de skad si tu padma'i ming can gyis// sgrub pa gsang sngags g.yar ngor spel ba dge/ maṅga lam/// / ༈ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dngos mchog /rje btsun bdud las rnam rgyal dpal 'brug pa'i// zhabs la phyag 'tshal skal ldan rgyud smin grol// byin rlabs char chen deng 'dir dbab tu gsol// rang rig gdod nas lhan skyes gnyug ma'i sems// gsol 'debs mos gus 'khor chos mtha' med par// zhen log nges 'byung rnam dag gzhir byas nas// 'gro la snying brtse'i byang chub sems bskyed cing*// yengs med sgom med ma bcos so ma'i ngang*// mnyam par bzhag cing dus gsum dge tshogs rnams// bdag gis gtsor bya ma gyur 'gro ba'i don// byang chub go 'phang thob phyir bsngo smon gyi// rgyas gdab dad dang dam tshig gces spras su// srung sdom g.yel med rtag par theg chen gyi// sems bskyed rgya chen rgyun du skyong bar 'tshal// de skad si tu padma'i ming can gyis// dpal dga' sprul skur gdams pa'i chos su spel// shu bham/// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus padma 'byung*// dbyer med karma ka dang 'brug pa'i zhabs// 'di nas byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag /'du 'bral med par byin chen dbab tu gsol// skal ldan rgyud grol dbang bzhi'i ye shes kyi// go 'phang dam pa bde blag nyid thob nas// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i don du rlabs chen gyi// phrin las thogs pa med par byin gyis rlobs// rang sems ngo bo stong zhing gsal ba la// ma 'gags sna tshogs rnam par rtog pa'i phreng*// sngon bsu rjes dpyod med par da ltar gyi// shes pa so ma ma bcos de ngang la// ngo bo skyong zhing mnyam par bzhag par gnad// dus kun rtsa ba'i bla mar bcos min gyi// mos gus ltem rkyang med dang mkha' khyab 'gror// byams dang snying rje phyogs med 'byongs pa dang*// sdom gsum skyon bral gsang sngags dam tshig la// sel med sgo nas rang dang gzhan don skyongs// zhes pa padma'i ming can si tu pas// 'dzi sgar byang 'dren legs bshad ngor spel dge// /

༈ dus gsum rnam par rtog pa'i chos thams cad// lhan skyes ye shes gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gyi// ka dag spros dang bral ba'i klong yangs su// kun tu bzang po'i dgongs don myur rtogs shog / dad can dge slong thabs mkhas ngor spel/// / ༈ gdams pa don du gnyer ba'i mos ldan dag /gson dang rang re chos gzugs 'dzin pa rnams// dang po skyabs 'gro'i sdom dang dge bsnyen dang*// rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs sogs sngon byon gyi// lugs srol ji bzhin de yi rjes zhugs slob// deng dus rtsod ldan snyigs lnga'i skabs 'dir yang*// dge ba'i phyogs la 'dun pa'ang skal bzang rmad// des na so thar srung sdom rtsa bzhi chang*// phra rags gang nus bsrung zhing rnam pa kun// sdig spong dge sgrub rang gzhan sman pa'i blos// chos tshugs blang dor rang yid ches pa yi// sdom pa dam tshig ngo lkog thub pa gnad// ye shes spyan ldan mi khrel bya ba gces// chos kyi snying po gnas lugs phyag rgya che// rig pa rang grol sangs rgyas rang byung gzhi// bla mar mos gus 'khor bar zhen log dang*// las 'bras zhib dpyod byams dang snying rje sbyong*// gang shar gnyug ma chos sku'i nyams len la// khor yug skyong ba'i bsam gtan mnyam bzhag dang*// rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nyid las// lhan skyes ye shes rang ngo 'phrod pa yi// chos sku'i go 'phang bde blag bsgrub par rigs// de skad bslab bya mdor bsdus gdams pa'i tshul// bkod 'di si tu padma'i ming can gyis// skal ldan yid kyi shing rta 'gengs phyir spel// dge des 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog /sarba maṅga lam/ bha wantu/// / ༈ chos rnams kun gyi gzhi rten mchog gyur pa// sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi btsal rang gi sems// dus gsum spros mtshan dri mas ma bslad par// gdod nas stong gsal snang ba 'gags med rtsal// ma bcos gang shar so ma'i ngang du zhog

/bsam brjod blo las 'das pa phyag rgya che// gnas lugs chos sku'i rang zhal gsal ston pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog / mos ldan gang de'i ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ oṃ swasti/ rang sems skye med chos kyi sku// padma 'byung gnas yongs shar bas// deng 'dir gnas lugs mngon gyur gyi// rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin shog /bla mar mos gus 'bral med brten// 'khor bar zhen log nges 'byung gi// rten 'brel dge tshogs bar med sgrubs// kun gzhi bder gshegs snying po'i don// mi rtog gnas par mi zhen cing*// 'khrul pa'i drwa bar mi 'thums par// rang bab rang bzhin rig pa'i rgyun// sems nyid gsal stong spros bral gyi// lta ba mthar thug ma bcos ngang*// rang gsal skyong ba bsgom pa ste// 'phro 'dur snang yang gnyug ma'i gshis// yengs med ngo bo skyong phyin chad// spyod lam tha mal mi 'gyur zhing*// de phyir bskyed bzlas rang rig klong*// snang stong zung 'jug rol rtsal las// gang shar spang blang bral bar spyod// chos kun snying po zab lam gyi// rtsa ba rang rig skyong la 'du// de ltar grub thob gcod yul gyi// brgyud 'dzin sbas tshul rnal 'byor pa// bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel gyi// bzhed ngor thugs dam gsos 'gyur phyir// padma nyin byed dbang pos spel// tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog// / ༈ rang sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i gshis// ka dag ngo bo kun tu bzang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal// gu ru padma 'byung gnas dran// dran tsam nyid nas snang srid kyi// chos rnams ye dag sems su 'du// de yang dbyings rig dbyer med pa// gang shar shar grol klong thim shog / ces pa'ang bde dga'i ngor spel/// / ༈ dus gsum rnam par rtog pa'i chos thams cad// 'dzin med byar med rang bab ma bcos par// yengs med chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ngang*/

spyod lam kun tu dran rdzi ma bral bar// sems nyid chos sku'i rang zhal gcer mthong gi// rang rgyud rig rtsal kun bzang myur thob shog / ces pa'ang bla ma dge legs rgya mtsho'i ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag rgyud bskul nas// las 'bras blang dor 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems maṇḍal dang*// bla ma'i rnal 'byor yi dam bskyed rdzogs sogs// sngon 'gro'i chos rnams 'bad cing dngos gzhi ni// phyag rgya che dang rdzogs pa che zhes pa// dgongs pa mdor dril nyams len rtsa ba la// bla mar mos gus 'khor bar zhen log rnams// gzhir byas yengs med sgom gyi rtsa ba ste// de yang rgyun du dran rdzi ma bral tsam// gnas pa ched du mi bsgrub rnam rtog gi// rjes su mi 'brang ma bcos rang babs kyi// shes pa so ma de ngang lhod der bzhag /gsal stong 'dzin med dbyings rig dbyer med par// gang shar chos sku'i rol par skyong ba gnad// de ltar rig pa gzhi thog yengs med ngang// spyod lam rnam bzhir 'bad pas ring min du// rang byung lhan skyes gdod nas rdo rje 'chang*// mngon gyur 'ja' lus 'od skur sangs rgyas shog / ces pa'ang si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos dad gsum rnam dag drung ram bla mchan nor bu'i bzhed ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ rnam kun chos can dge spyod kun// ci nus bsgrub cing mos gus dang*// dag snang phyogs med sbyong ba yi// dngos kun chos nyid snang ba yi// rtog tshogs sems kyi cho 'phrul rnams// gang shar ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang*// rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo skyongs// ces pa'ang bla ma phrin las rab rgyas bzhed ltar spel ba bkra shis/// / ༈ dal 'byor rin chen lus bzang rten mchog thob// ma nor lam ston dpal ldan rdo rje can// dam pa rnams kyis rim pas rjes bzung nas// bslab pa rnam dag smin dbang grol khrid kyi// gdams pas rgyud brlan skal bar ldan par nges// byams dang snying rjes kun bslang ris med 'gror// khyab pa'i bsam pa brtan cing dge ba'i las// che phra kun kyang rang gzhan bla med kyi// don du bsngo zhing khyad par stong nyid kyi// lta ba'i ngang nas mnyam bzhag skyong ba ste// de yang 'das rjes ma 'ongs rnam rtog bsal// shes rig so ma gang shar bzo med bskyang*// de la rim gyis goms 'dris mthar phyin gnad// kun gyi rtsa ba mos gus gdung shugs dang*// 'khor bar zhen log chos la nges 'byung bskyed// las 'bras blang dor phra zhib 'dzem pa dang*// sdom pa dam tshig ngos lkog med pa ru// ji nus bsrung zhing lus ngag dge la 'bad// dug lnga'i dbang du ma gyur gnyen po yi// stobs kyis slebs pa'i dran pa'i rtsis zin ngang*// gang shar ma bcos gnas lugs bskyang ba na// skabs shig don gyi ye shes ngo bo nyid// phyag rgya che dang rdzogs pa che zhes pa// dbyer med rgyal ba gong ma gshegs pa'i shul// lam bzang bla med kun 'dus rig pa'i rtsal// chos sku sgrib bral mngon gyur mthong zhes par// gong ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig gsungs pa bzhin// shes rab ldan pas bsam gtan g.yo med par// brtson 'grus dang bcas 'bad pas 'grub par 'gyur// des na dran rdzi ma bral ngang de nas// chos kun sems su thag bcad gdeng ldan pas// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rnal 'byor bsgrub par 'tshal// de skad skal ldan las 'phro bsod nams can// lha yi bzo 'phrul rmad byung thar mchog ces// gang de'i bskul ba don ldan bya phyir du// si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos spel// dge des gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po yi// ye shes mngon sum rang gzhan rgyud smin nas// sku bzhi'i go 'phang tshe 'dir thob nas su// thar pa mchog gi sa la 'god par shog

/sarba maṅga laṃ su dza yantu/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ skyabs kun 'dus pa rgyal mchog karma ka /bdud 'dul rdo rje skye dang tshe rabs phreng*/ byang chub snying po'i bar du 'bral med par/ snying gi thig ler rtag bzhugs byin gyis rlobs/ 'phags pa'i sar gnas mchog rnams gshegs pa'i shul// skal ldan las can grol dang smin byed lam// phyag rgya che zhes zab don rmad byung ba// mthar thug don gyi yang bcud man ngag rnams// rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyi gsung dri med// mu tig phreng 'dra lta bu'i gsung gsang mdzod// kun tu gsal bzhin de nyid gzhir bzhag pa'i// sngon 'gro dang ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa las// dang po bsags sbyang tshogs gnyis rlabs chen po// sems kyi dri ma spangs pa'i theg chen gyi// bsam sbyor dang bcas de yang rang rgyud dul// nges 'byung skyo shas mos gus gzhi brtan cing*// dad dang tshul khrims bag yod dam tshig gtsang*// 'gro la nye ring bral ba'i byams pa dang*// stong nyid snying rje lta ba'i gdeng ldan pas// dge kun ma gyur 'gro la bsngo bar 'bad// dngos gzhi phyag rdzogs dbyer med zung 'jug pa// shes pa so ma de ngang ma bcos par// byar med lhug par bzhag nas yengs med ngang*// rtsol sgrub re dogs spang blang med par bskyang*// de nyid rgyun du goms 'dris mthar phyin gnad// khyad par brgyud pa byin rlabs tshan kha che// bslu med bla mar gsol 'debs kho nar 'bungs// skabs zhig don gyi ye shes 'char zhes gsungs// des na rang sems chos kun 'dus pa la// chos skur rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag rgyun bskyang bya// gzhan yang rnam dkar dge ba gang 'grub dang*// las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas su// snying po'i bstan la bya ba byed pa yi// thos bsam sgrub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin pa dang*// 'gro la phan bde'i go 'phang sbyin nus pa'i// 'brel tshad thar pa'i lam bkod phrin las kyi// snying stobs go cha 'chang la dpa' ba yi// 'phags chen spyan ras gzigs bzhin 'grub gyur cig

/de skad bla ma snyan grags dpal bzang po'i// bzhed ngor si tu padma nyin byed kyis// spel dges 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang thob shog /dge'o/// / ༈ dad ldan karma smon lam zhes pa nas// rang tshul mol mchid der gsal ltar 'byor ba// rgyal dbang bcu gsum rdo rje 'chang chen po// dngos su zhal mjal byin rlabs 'pho dbang thob// skal bzang skal bar ldan pa'i skye sngon gyi// las 'phro'i bsod nams ldan las gzhan du ci// 'on kyang 'dir snang zhen 'dzin chos brgyad kyi// bdud bzhi'i rlung la mi g.yeng dal rten 'di// snying por bya phyir rang la rags las phyir// des na mos gus ltem rkyang ma song bar// rang sems ngo bo bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du// 'char ba'i ma bcos de ngang snang rig kun// dus gsum rtog pa'i drwa bas ma bcings pa'i// gang shar 'dzin med skyong ba'i nyams len gyi// mnyam par bzhag dang rjes thob gnyis 'dzin chos// thams cad sgyu ma'i snang bar 'char ba yi// yod min med min zung 'jug lta ba'i gdeng*// yengs med chu rgyun lta bu'i rnal 'byor 'tshal// rang gzhan sgo gsum dge la bkol ba yi// bsags sbyang ci nus 'bad pas dang len nas// sdig las che phra spang pa'i yid dam bzung*// nam zhig kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po zhes// chos sku dri med rig pa'i rang rtsal gyi// ngo bo gcer mthong brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'jug /de phyir tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i chos// gzhan du ma mchis de ltar phyag rdzogs sogs// nyams len ngang nas rang sems skyong ba gnad// bstan 'gro'i bde thabs spel phyir smon bden tshig /dgos zhes de ltar bsam pa lhun grub dang*// rigs gsum snying po gnas mchod sogs la 'bad// de las kho bo'i tshig ris 'bras bu dben// ngal ba'i rgyur snang de ltar yid nges 'tshal// nyams su len pa'i snod dang ldan gyur na// gsar rnying chos rnams dgos 'byung nor bu bzhin// de phyir gzhan du gsar rtsom dang gter chos// sna tshogs 'di dag nying 'khrul chu shing dper// ji bzhin nges pas cal sgrog rjes 'jug spongs// rang sems dpang btsugs dad dang dam tshig la// gces spras dge sgrub sdig spang rnam kun tu// yig drug dung phyur bzlas la brtson par zhu// slad nas dge tshogs yar zla ltar 'phel smon// lha rdzas sngags mdud dam rdzas dang bcas te// dpal spungs chos grwa'i yang dben khang nas spel// maṅga lam/// /

༈ sngon smon rnam dkar dge 'bras dus smin pas// dal 'byor rten bzang bslab gsum rgyan ldan pa'i// mtshungs bral dad dam ldan pa gang nyid kyi// thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes rim pa yang*// 'khrul med dam pa'i gsung dang rjes mthun par// dus gsum rnam par rtog pa ji snyed pa// rtog med rig pa'i rang rtsal kho na ru// shar bas dug lnga la sogs nyon mongs tshogs// shar grol dus mnyam rig pa rang grol phyir// spros bral gnas lugs rtogs par som nyi ci// mi slob rab tu dga' ba'i sa yang non// de phyir da dung de ltar rgyun skyong dang*// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par nges//

zhes pa'ang 'brug pa bla ma'i bzhed ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ swasti/ sngon smon bzang pos tshogs zung 'bras smin pas// dal rten mchog thob snying po'i bstan la zhugs// mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon rnams dang mjal// chos kyi snod rung rjes su bzung nas su// gdams ngag zab chos smin grol lam bzang bkod// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// zab lam nā ro chos drug nyams len dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya chen po yi// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi ji bzhin bsgrub nas su// mos gus dang ni zhen log nges 'byung gis// rgyud bskul brtson 'grus mtha' ru phyin pa'i mthus// gol shor 'phrang las grol te gdod ma'i gshis// gnas lugs chos sku'i rang zhal dri med par// mthong la yi rang sim pa ci yang bskyed// slad du'ang las 'bras blang dor zhib spyod cing*// byang chub sems bskyed gzhan phan rtsa ba brtan// dad gsum rnam dag dam tshig gces spras dang*// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa lhur len nas// snang srid chos sku'i rol pa 'char bzhin du// yengs med bsgom par de nyid chos kun 'dus// rdo rje 'chang chen tilli nā ro pa// mar pa mi la dwags po dus mkhyen sogs// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// ye shes chos skyong tshogs kyi thugs rje'i mthus// chos ltar bcos pa'i 'khrul pa rgyang bsring zhing*// ma nor nges don snying po'i gnas gzhol nas// ston pa'i bstan la bya ba byed pa dang*// 'brel bcas thar pa'i lam du bkod bzhin par// rang rig ye shes mngon du gyur nas su// don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// de skad shar phyogs gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro// yang dag lam ston 'dul 'dzin dge ba'i bshes// ngur smrig 'chang ba bla ma nā tha zhes// gang de'i bzhed ngor o rgyan lung zin tsam// si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos spel// dge des 'gro kun bla med sangs rgyas shog

/ ces dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi yang dben sgrub khang nas dge// / ༈ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// snying po don brgyud rnams dang rang sems dang*// dbyer med 'du 'bral med ngang rnam kun du// chos mthun gsol gdab bsags sbyang sngon 'gro'i rigs// 'bad cing sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin la// byang chub sems kyi rtsi yis zin pa nas// tshad med bzhi ldan sgo nas 'gro phan du// phyogs ris med par sman sbyin btang ba las// sems kyi dri ma nam yang ring du spongs// bstan sgor 'jug pa'i skal bzang bslab sdom la// gso sbyang dang ni sha chang bag yod gnad// bstan dang bla ma dge 'dun spyi yi don// lhag bsam dag pas lhur len gang 'grub dang*// rnam kun dge sgrub sdig spang tshad ldan bya// dran rig yengs med ngo bo skyong bzhin du// nyin snang sgyu ma rmi lam rtogs byas nas// mtshan snang de yi la zlar goms 'dris kyi// ma yengs de ngang spyod lam brtan byas na// chos sku'i rang rtsal sems kyi ngo mthong zhes// rdo rje'i gsung gsang dag las byung ba bzhin// byin rlabs 'pho dbang nges thob skal ldan gyi// nyams len mos thob 'tsho byed sman bla yis// bskul phyir si tu padmas bkod pa'i dges// rang gzhan don gnyis yongs grub byin gyis rlobs/// / ༈ bka' brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// sems gang shar rig pa hrig ge ba// phyi snang ba'i yul phyir mi 'brang zhing*// nang 'dzin pas ma bslad rjen lhang nge// de mnyam rjes res 'jog ma yin cing*// rkyen bzang zhan gang shar de ngang skyong*// mos gus can sgom gyi mgo bo dang*// zhen log can sgom gyi rkang pa zhes// sngon grub brnyes rnam thar tshul bzhin du// rjes slob pa'i dge bas nam zhig tu// sems chos sku'i rang zhal mthong ngo zhes// lha bris pa bstan 'dzin g.yar ngo ru// si tu pa padma'i ming des spel/// /

༈ gang khyod sngon tshe tshogs zung gi// bsags sbyangs legs smon dge de yis// dal rten mchog thob snying po'i bstan// sgor zhugs chos zab lam ma nor// phyag rdzogs nyams len skal bzang thob// chos kun rtsa ba sems nyid de// rig pa hrig ger rang sar zhog /legs nyes rtsis gdab mi bya bar// dus gsum rnam rtog rjes mi 'brang*// de ltar yang yang goms pa na// sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral gyi// chos sku'i ngo bo rang zhal mthong*// de'ang mos gus zhen log dang*// dam tshig dge sdig blang dor gnad// bka' brgyud gong ma'i byin rlabs kyi// ye shes rgyud smin grol gyur cig / si tu pas gcod bla tshe dbang bzhed ltar spel/// / ༈ ka dag gdod ma'i mgon la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sems nyid lhan skyes rang byung rig pa'i don// gtan la 'bebs pa'i ye shes ngo sprad phyir// tha mal 'khrul pa rgya 'byams rnam rtog gi /rjes su mi 'brang ma 'ongs mdun mi bsu// da lta'i shes pa so ma'i ngang du bzhag /de la bcas bcos gnas dga' 'gyu sdug spangs// gang shar de yi gnas lugs rgyun du skyongs// ma gyur sems can 'gro la phan sems kyi// byang sems snying rje bskyed cing rnam kun du// dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// mos gus dad dang dam tshig mos blo yi// rtsa ba brtan cing 'khor bar zhen log gi// bsam pa 'gyur ba med cing dus thams cad// sgo gsum dge ba'i las la bkol bar bya// ci byed chos kyi phyogs la 'bad pas na// nam zhig chos sku bde ba chen po yi// go 'phang rang rgyud bde blag thob par 'gyur// ces pa'ang lha sras rin po che'i bzhed dgongs ltar si tu padma'i ming gis bkod pa'o/// / ༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs// ye shes rdo rje yi ngo bo nyid// gdod nas yongs grub kyi rdo rje 'chang*// zla 'od gzhon nu la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung rig pa dang dbyer med ngang*// kun khyab lhan skyes kyi rang mdangs rtsal// kun bzang bde chen gyi rol pa ru// snang bzhin du bde gsal mi rtog pa'i// gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma spros dang bral// lam 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i gshis// yin la yin bzhin pa'i thugs rje'i 'od// byin rlabs kyi zer thag 'gog med par// bdun brgyud du nges par zab mo'i don// ye shes gtad tsam gyis smin grol lam// bkod pa yi zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la// rje nā ro dngos sprul dpal 'brug pa'i// chos bdud rtsi'i nying khu yang bcud 'di// zhal brgyud nas mnga' bdag lo tsā che// dgyes mdzad kyi sgyu 'phrul gar rol pa// grub rnams kyis dbugs dbyung ming dbang gis// gsal ba ru mngon par gzengs bstod pa'i// rje sangs rgyas ras chen skyes rabs phreng*// 'dzin pa po padma'i ming can la// rgyud byin rlabs rdo rje bzhi dbang gis// deng rtogs grol yon tan sim pa ste// snyigs dus 'dir las can dam tshig can// kun gyi spyi nor du gzhan phan blos// mos pas spel bgyi na snod ldan gyi// skal ldan rnams dwangs pa cher bskyed la// gzhi mos gus 'dun pa brtan po yis// lam bzang 'dir 'jug pa yod srid na// gnad byin rlabs thugs rje'i rten 'brel dbang*// las smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar mthus// rten thog 'dir mchog gnyis grub pa yi// dngos grub bde blag tu thob par nges// rang dang gzhan sems can ris med 'gro// thar pa'i go 'phang du bkod pa la// sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog thob par shog

/ ces rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon pa'i gter byon gsang lam bla sgrub brgyud pa bdun bar du/ slob ma snod ldan gyur na/ grol ba mngon gyur zhal bzhes snang bar/ kho bo bdun par nges shes brtan thob zla sprul pas nyams len dang*/ rten zhal thang bzhes par smon lam bskul ngor/ si tu padma nyin mor byed pas spel bris chos 'di 'brel tshad smin grol don dang ldan par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ sngon tshe dge tshogs bzang po'i 'bras smin mthus// dal rten mchog thob nges don bstan sgor zhugs// ma nor lam ston yongs 'dzin rnams dang mjal// shākya'i rjes 'jug slob pa'i skal bzang dang*// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mor// smin cing grol nas rgyud byin brlab pa dang*// byang chub sems bskyed rtsis zin sdom gsum gyi// dam tshig gces spras rnam kun 'bad par gnad// deng 'dir dam chos phyag rgya chen po gang*// bgo skal thob 'di brgya lam res 'ga' tsam// don brgyud bka' gsang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dri med// yid la sim pa e ma ngo mtshar rmad// thun mong sngon 'gro chos bzhis blo sbyangs nas// thun min skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sgrib sbyong dang*// tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor yi dam gyi// bskyed bzlas dngos gzhi nyams len rtsa ba ste// rnam kun 'khor ba'i las la zhen log gi// rgyu 'bras phra zhib spang blang 'chol med cing*// bla mar mos gus ltem rkyang ma shor bar// snying nas the tshom bral ba'i gsol 'debs 'bungs// mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhal snga nas// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// snang sems dbyer med bde stong lhan cig skyes// lhan skyes rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// ces gsungs tha mal sems 'di gdod ma nas// chos skur gnas kyang glo bur a 'thas kyi// dri mas sgrib bzhin de dag bsal ba'i phyir// tshogs drug snang ba gang shar bden med du// sgyu ma'i rang mdangs rmi lam ci bzhin par// rtogs nas snang sems ro gcig 'du shes ngang*// ma bcos rang babs yengs med nyams len skyongs*// rnam kun dran rdzi brtan cing dus gsum gyi// rnam rtog mi 'phreng ched du'ang mi bkag par// ma yengs tsam du mnyam par bzhag pa dang*// spyod lam kun du g.yel med rtag par 'bad// zhi gnas skyon bral rab tu brtan pa na// rang rig lhag ger mthong ba'i nges shes thob// 'on kyang bde gsal mi rtog nyams bzang la'ang*// zhen 'dzin spangs nas ma bcos rang ngo skyongs// rim bzhin rtse gcig spros bral sgom med sogs// rtogs pa mngon gyur tha mal snang zhen bral// rang rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur na// gzhan don phrin las rlabs chen spyod pa dang*// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rgyal sa thob par nges// gnas skabs chos ldan bshes dang mi 'bral zhing*// sgrub pa mthar phyin tshe ring nad med cing*// gegs dang gol sa mi mthun gnod pa zhi// don gnyis bsam don lhun grub 'byung bar smon// de skad tshul 'dir 'dun pa'i mos pa can// dad gsum ldan pa karma bkra chos pas// ring nas bskul bar don yod bya ba'i phyir// si tu padma'i ming gis bkod pa ste// dge bas rang gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// rdo rje 'chang dbang dbyer med 'grub gyur cig

/shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ rgyal ba gong ma dag gi bgrod gcig lam// zab mo phyag chen gnad la brtson byas na// brgyad khri bzhi stong lam gyi nyams len kun// gcig char rgyud la rdzogs par rtsod pa bral// des na bla ma'i mos gus gzhir bzung ste// ma yengs mi bsgom ngang la dran rig gis// zin tsam de las spros pa kun spang ba'i// lam 'dir mos pas kun nas 'jug par mdzod// skyabs kun 'dus kyi sangs rgyas karma pa// yid mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po yis// 'bral med du snying dbus 'chang lags na// brjod bral gyi lhan skyes ye shes dngos// tshegs med du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// dbon karma bstan pa'i ngor spel/// / ༈ na mo shrī ya na utta ra badzra ye/ sngon bsags legs byas kyi rang gzugs bdo ba'i// dbang shugs kyi dal brgyad 'byor bcu thob cing*// de las kyang rgyal bas rjes su 'dzin phyir// mi mngon gyi dbyings nas gzigs pa bzhis dgongs// mchog gi snang brnyan skyed byed kyi yum gyur// dam pa'i rnam thar la mi phyed 'dun pa// phyogs med kyi dag snang 'byongs shing rnam kun// byams pa dang snying rjes yongs la phan bde'i// lhag bsam gyi zla zer dkar pos khyab pa'i// nges don la phyogs pa'i nyams len gnad gsang*// snying por bsgril ba'i rnal 'byor la gzhol pa// kha tsam du ma yin gting nas gus pa// mtshan ldan slob ma skal ba can 'phags ma'i// rnam par 'phrul shes rab ma yi zol 'dzin// gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes rang brnyes mod// tshur mthong ngor theg pa la rim 'jug gis// smon pa'i chos kun gyi yang rtse'i tog gyur// bla mar gsol btab zab lam gyi gdung dbyangs// ring nas bskul pa don yod kyi ched du// gang shar ngang nas 'di skad du gsol lo// kye ho/ thog med kyi dus ring nas nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i// 'khrul pa yang 'khrul rgya 'byams kyi drwa bar 'thums nas// 'khor ba'i las la zad med chu bo'i rgyun lta bu// bzlog tu med pa'i sems can la brtse bas dgongs shig

/rtsod ldan dus 'dir rgyal ba dang rgyal sras slob tshogs// lhag par thugs bskyed dam bca' rtsal sprugs kyi ngang nas// gzugs skur bzhengs pa kun rdzob ngor tha dad ston kyang*// don dam skye 'gags gnas med kyi dbyings su gcig pas// rang sems lhan skyes chos sku yi klong yangs su dran chog /dwangs ma'i mgon po snying gi ti la kar gdod gnas// kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba karma ka mkhyen no// snang srid bla ma'i rol pa ru shar bar byin rlobs// zhes so// de skad rgyal yum dgongs bskang phyir// spyi brtol bskyed pa'i tshig gi phreng*// padma nyin byed dbang gis smras// dge des chos sku thob gyur cig /shu bham/// / ༈ e ma/ ring nas bsod nams ye shes 'du byas pa'i// dal rten lus thob de las khyad par du// rgyal ba'i mched lcam tshul du gnas pa yi// bag chags bzang pos bskul bas chos kyi sgor// 'jug cing lhag pa'i blo dang rab ldan pa'i// don dam gnas lugs phyogs la 'dun pa can// de tshul gleng ba'i gdams pa don gnyer ba// skal bzang skal bar ldan pa'i rang bzhin nges// de'ang dang por mi rtag rgyud bskul zhing*// 'khor ba'i chos la blo log byang chub sems// phyogs med 'byong zhing mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum// kun 'dus ngo bo dran mchog bla ma la// rnam kun mos gus ltem rkyang med pa yi// gsol 'debs ngang nas dus gsum rnam rtog kun// rgyun bcad gang shar so ma'i ngo bo skyongs// ma bcos rang babs dran pa'i rgyang so ni// ma bral ngang la lhan ner 'jog pa gnad// de yang spyod lam rnam pa thams cad du// nyams len rtsi yis zin bzhin yengs med kyis// de la goms 'dris brtan pa cher thob na// zhi gnas lhag mthong la sogs rim bzhin par// rtogs pa na 'phar rang sems chos kyi sku// gnas lugs de kho na nyid mngon gyur nas// bla med sku bzhi'i rgyal sa mchog thob 'gyur//

ces pa'ang rje btsun ma'i dgongs bzhed ltar gdams pa'i tshul du si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa'o/// / ༈ a ho/ rigs kun gyi khyab bdag bka' drin can// dpal padma 'byung gnas karma ka /dbyer med pa spyi bo'i rgyan mchod nas// deng mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs// phyi kun rdzob sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor la// bden zhen 'dzin a 'thas ther zug gi// blo rnam rtog phreng ba lug rgyud bzhin// gang shar ba'i 'gyu ba de ngang lhod// yid ma bcos 'dzin bral snang zhing stong*// don gsal la 'gags med rang zhal ltos// blos byas kyi rtsol bas ma bslad par// gnas dga' dang 'phro ba'i re dogs spang*// yengs med kyi dran rdzi'i rgyang so btsugs// spyod lam kun gnyug ma'i ngo bo skyongs// mtshan snang gi nying 'khrul ldog med par// lam khyer phyir sems kyi 'phen par btang*// nyams len gyi rtsi dang ma bral na// gnyid 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por rtogs// sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das// dug lnga bcom ye shes lnga dang ldan// 'khor ba las 'das pas de nyid dang*// sems can du btags pa'i 'khrul 'byams mkhan// nyon mongs pa'i phung po 'di dag kyang*// don sems nyid rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad// gzhi gcig las lam gnyis gsungs pa'i phyir// rang re rnams dal 'byor thob dus 'dir// chos phyir du dka' ba spyad nas su// chos ma nor phyag rdzogs nyams len sgoms// chos gegs 'du 'dzi yi rnam g.yeng spongs// chos min 'dres khyer rigs rgyang bskyur la// chos blang dor ji bzhin dbye bsal gnad// chos dam tshig dad pa 'gyur med brtan// chos sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la mos pas// chos rang byung lhan skyes ye shes kyi// chos rang rdol sems kyi rdo rje che// chos smra bsam las 'das kun bzang gi// dgongs don mchog rtogs pa'i skal ldan nas// rang gzhan kun phyam gcig byang chub kyi// go 'phang la dkri ba'i nus thob des// 'khor ba rnams dong sprugs sangs rgyas shog

/de skad ces gsang sngags rnying ma yi// chos brgyud 'dzin grub dbang rim byon gyi// gnas gdan sa skyong ba'i las smon can// dbon bla ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin zhes// ming don mtshungs gang de'i dad pa'i gsos// rgyas phyir du bzhed pa bskang ba'i blos// si tu pa padma nyin byed kyis// gsal gdab kyi tshul du bkod pa dge// maṅga lam/// / ༈ sku gsum ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes// rgyal bas lung zin nges pa'i skyes mchog la// dad gus mos blo 'gyur ldog bral ba yis// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo ru// rtsa brgyud bla ma ye shes klong gcig par// rang rig lhan skyes chos sku dbyer med ngang*// skye 'gags gnas bral gang shar 'dzin med kyi// mi bsgom ma yengs rig pa'i rgyun bskyang nas// ma yengs dran pa'i rtsi dang ma bral gnad// tha mal snang ba rgya 'byams ma yin par// snang srid chos rnams rang rig rang rtsal las// gzhan du ma grub de phyir nyams len gyi// gnad gsang sems nyid spros bral nyid la 'dus// rang sems chos skur rtogs pa'i thabs zab mo// tshe gcig rdor 'chang go 'phang thob par nges//

ces pa'ang si tu padma'i ming can gyis// gnas mdo chos grwa'i dge bshes dad dam can// las skal ldan pa rnams kyi bgo skal chos// gdams pa'i dge des chos sku mngon gyur shog /// ༈ bka' brgyud gong ma rnam gsum la phyag 'tshal// gang nyid sngon bsags las smon dus smin cing*// brgyud pa'i byin rlabs tshan kha ma nyams bzhin// sngon 'gro'i yon tan tshul bzhin skyes pa legs// dngos gzhi nyams kyi skabs te ci ltar yang*// rdo rje 'chang sogs don brgyud bla ma la// gsol 'debs bla ma'i rnal 'byor gzhir bzung nas// bde gsal mi rtog 'phro rgod bying rmugs sogs// bde dang mi bde'i 'dzin rtog gang 'char ba'i// ngo bor bltas tshe rang grol chu rlabs bzhin// spros bral rig stong rang ngo 'phrod par nges// ma bcos so ma lhug par zhog cig ces// bka' brgyud khrid dang zhal gdams thams cad las// bshad kyang bzhag thabs gnad khel dka' bar snang*// 'on kyang spang blang bcos sgyur re dogs kyi// 'ching ba kun bral ma yengs tsam du ni// ngo bo kho na bskyang las phyag chen gyi// nyams len 'di zhes smra brjod yul las 'das// des na stong pa phyang chad la sogs pa// gol shor bzhi po'i lam log rgyang bsrings te// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug theg mchog lam// 'khrul med nyams len mthar phyin 'bad 'tshal zhu// de skad si tu padma'i ming can gyis// dge rgyal rje drung sprul skur gdams pa dge// / ༈ rgyal ba gong ma'i phyag chen khrid rim las// tshig dang yi ges nam yang bstan du med// bla mar sangs rgyas shes pas gsol 'debs dang*// byin rlabs mthu yis nang nas sgrog khrol dgos// dang po'i las can sems 'dzin zhi gnas sgrub// goms nas lhag mthong rang ngo shes pa nas// rnal 'byor bzhi rim go rtogs myong ba skye// de'ang mi nyams gong du spel ba'i phyir// zhen log nges 'byung las 'bras bag yod sogs// sgom gyi bdag po yin pas tshul bzhin bsten// chos mkhas sgom bzang nga rgyal gting nas spongs// bde chen zhing du smon lam yang yang thob// tshul des gtan bde'i go 'phang thob par nges// de skad dad gsum ldan pa tshe brtan ngor// si tus spel dges don gnyis yongs 'grub shog// /

༈ 'khor 'das gnyis chos kun sems kyi rang mdangs// snang ba 'khrul pa'i rjes 'brang 'di 'khor ba'i gzhi ma// de rjes mi 'brang bar rang ngo shes bzhin// rig rtsal thog bab tu 'jog pa nyams len gyi mthil so// mi g.yel lho chags dbon mdzod mkhas grub ngor spel/// / ༈ rang nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spyi bo ru// dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo padma'i mtshan// rab byung cha lugs gsal bar bskyed nas su// 'di bzung byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// dad gsum mos pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mchog /bde blag nyid du thob par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig / ces dang*/ sems kyi bzhag thabs ni/ rang sems gdod nas chos skur gnas pa la// bsag sbyang mos gus bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// rang ngo shes bzhin 'khrul rjes mi 'brang bar// stong gsal 'dzin med ma bcos ngang la bzhag /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i bsngo smon bya// sdig spang dge sgrub rnam kun 'bad par byos// bzo rig tshangs dbyangs dang*/ lha 'od ngor spel/// / ༈ bka' brgyud gong ma gshegs shul phyag rgya che'i// nyams len gnad la rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bor gsol 'debs pa// mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa yin// bar du rang sems rig rig tur tur po// bde gsal mi rtog nyams kyi snang cha la// zhen med rang ngo rtag tu skyong ba ni// yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhi zhes su grags// tshe 'di'i 'dod yon rigs rus chos brgyad la// zhen med dge rtsa che phra gang 'grub pa// phyi bshol med par lag len 'debs pa ni// zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa zhes byar gsungs// gegs sel bogs 'don ngo sprod la sogs pa'i// gnad 'gag thams cad nges par 'dir tshang bas// nyams su blangs pas tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang tshegs med nyid du 'grub gyur cig

/de skad si tu padma'i ming can gyis// dge ma tshangs spyod dpal mo'i bzhed ngor spel/// / ༈ ma hā mu dra siddhi hūm̐/ sngon bsags dkar po'i 'bras smin dal rten thob// mtshan ldan bla ma mjal zhing chos dang 'phrad// dus 'dir sdig spong dge sgrub sems don gyi// tshul la mos pa de bzhin spro ba rmad// bka' brgyud byin rlabs rtsa ba mos gus dang*// snying rje dag snang sbyang pa gal che gsungs// de phyir sngon 'gro bsag sbyang chos rnams la// 'bad cing bla ma rdor 'chang ngo bo ru// spyi bor bsgom zhing dbang bzhi len pa dang*// 'od zhu rang thim sems nyid ma bcos ngang*// mnyam par bzhag cing ngo bo skyong ba gnad// dran rdzi 'bral med spyod lam rnam kun du// nyin snang thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin// bden med mtshan snang de bzhin bskyangs nas su// rnam rtog 'khrul ba'i dbang du ma song bar// rang bab rang bzhin rig pa'i rgyun skyong gnad// nam zhig rang sems rang ngo 'phrod pa yi// bla med sku bzhi'i rgyal sa zin par smon// de skad mos ldan dad can rnams kyi ngor// si tu padma'i ming gis smras pa dge// sarba dza ya/// / ༈ rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid gzod ma'i gshis// mi shigs mi 'gyur bzo med bde ba che'i// gnas lugs mngon gyur bka' brgyud rgya mtsho yis// lhan skyes ye shes snang ba rgyas byin rlobs// gang khyod sngon bsags las smon 'bras smin mthus// dal 'byor don ldan sgrub la 'bad brtson de'i// nyams myong rtogs pa na 'phar 'char sgo'i tshul// ji bzhin skyes la ngo mtshar yi rang gnas// da dung nyams la zhen dang tshe 'di'i 'khris// chos brgyad snang shas dbang du ma shor bar// las 'bras dam sdom phra zhib blang dor gnad// skabs su ro snyoms byang sems blo sbyong 'bad// rim bzhin sgo gsum rgyud smin grol gyur nas// sems nyid chos sku'i rang zhal mthong bar smon// de skad si tu padma'i ming can gyis// 'brong rigs sgrub pa karma dar rgyas ngor// nyams len gsal 'debs ched du bkod dge de'i// 'gro kun byang chub go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// maṅga lam/// /

༈ byin rlabs don brgyud mar mi dwags gsum la// gsol 'debs rang sems lhan skyes chos kyi sku// gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon sum rtogs gyur nas// sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob byin gyis rlobs// skye 'gags gnas bral ma bcos so ma'i ngang*// gang shar de yi ngo bo skyong bzhin du// sdom pa dam tshig sel med las 'bras kyi// blang dor gces spras rgyun spyod 'bad par 'tshal// zla bo dbu mdzad karma'i ngor spel ba dge/// / ༈ sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma'i gshis// yengs med rgyun skyong nam zhig tshe// bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral nas// spros bral chos sku mngon gyur shog /gnas skabs tshe nor chos gsum gyi// mnga' dbang 'byor pa'i dpal gyur cig / rtogs ldan phrin las chos dbang bskul ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ rigs kun khyab bdag bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// 'bral med bde chen 'khor lor rtag bzhugs bzhin// dam pa gang gis bka' mchid bstsal ba'i len// mdor bsdus gsol gyis thugs la 'chang bar rigs// sdom gsum dri med tshul bzhin bsrung ba dang*// tshogs gnyis chu gter gong du spel ba dang*// thun mong sngon 'gros rtag tu rgyud sbyong ba// 'di gsum rang don sgrub la med thabs med// tshad med snying rje phyogs ris bral ba dang*// bsdu ba'i dngos po rang 'dod ma gos dang*// dag snang rab 'byams ngo srung med pa ste// 'di gsum gzhan don sgrub la med thabs med// phyogs med thos pa'i nor gyis phyug pa dang*// thos don sgom pas rang rgyud dul ba dang*// de yi grogs su brtson 'grus rtsom pa gsum// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin la med thabs med// gtso bor mos gus rnal 'byor skyong ba dang*// chos brgyad snang shas rgyang du dor ba dang*// gnyug ma'i dran shes khor yug bsten pa gsum// sgrub brgyud rnam thar skyong la med thabs med// de phyir bka' brgyud rnam thar dri med la// rtag par rjes su slob cing 'bad par zhu// mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags yod dge ba'i mthus// dpal ldan karma pa yi phrin las mchog

/phyogs mthar 'dren pa'i shing rta dam pa mchog /rtag par 'tsho ga zhes phrin las rab rgyas shing*// dus gsum gshegs pa'i bka' brgyud rin chen gyi// dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs par skong byed shog / ces go shri sprul sku'i dgongs bzhed bzhin bkod pa phul ba dge /shu bham/// / ༈ nges pa don mchog bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng*// kun 'dus rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// rang sems dbyer med nyid du nges bzhin par// 'di bzung byang chub bar du thugs rjes skyongs// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// gdod gnas rang byung ye shes ngo bo nyid// ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags dbang gyur kyang*// bcom ldan rtsa 'dor zhabs kyi gdams ba'i bcud// gnyug ma'i shes pa gsal dwangs rnyog pa med// ngos bzung med cing 'phro gnas 'gro 'ong med// bcas bcos byar med rang gar glod la bzhag /glod pa'i sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu'o// ces gsungs byin rlabs mchog gyur nges ba 'di// de bzhin rnam kun nyams len skyong gyur na// sems nyid chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par smon// padma'i ming gis mgon sprul bzhed ngor spel// sarba thā shre yastu/// / ༈ gtan skyabs bla ma yid bzhin dus kun tu// gsol 'debs mos gus 'khor bar zhen log gi// rang sems dug gsum rtog pas ma bslad par// rang bzhin bzo bcos bral ngang mnyam par bzhag /dang por dug gsum rnam rtog mang 'gyu yang*// gang shar rang ngo shes pa'i thog tu glod// mdor na skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad kun// gang shar lam du khyer zhing bla ma la// blo gtad ling skyur sdig spang dge sgrub 'bad// las 'bras blang dor de yis bsam don 'grub// dad gsum ldan pa sog ru jo 'bum ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus ngo bo nyid// drug pa seng ge dpal ldan karma ka /bdud 'dul rdo rje spyi bo'i rgyan du mchod// rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya che rtogs shog

/bsag sbyang sngon du song ba'i las skal can// gang nyid sku 'tsho gzhom bral rtag brtan cing*// bslab gsum rnam dag tshul gnas thos sgom la// rnam kun gces spras bag yod nongs med zhu// snyigs dus rgyal ba'i bstan la mi gus pa'i// dmu rgod 'gro rnams mi bsrun brlang spyod la// skyo ba rgyang bsring pha rol phyin drug dang*// bsdu dngos bzhi yis bstan dang 'gro don skyongs// rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab bskyed rim gyi// rtsal sbyang tha mal snang zhen lha skur ldang*// bzlas pa sngags kyi 'khor lo rtag par 'bad// 'phro 'dus don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par bya// thun mong sngon 'gro bzhi yis rgyud bskul zhing*// nang pa sangs rgyas bstan la skyabs 'gros tshud// theg chen lam kyi gzhi ma sems bskyed 'bad// rigs 'dus rdor sems sgom bzlas sgrib gnyis sbyongs// tshogs zung myur rdzogs phyi nang maṇḍal dang*// byin rlabs rgyud smin bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgrubs// dbang bzhi'i ye shes rtogs grol thugs yid bsre// rang sems bla ma'i ngo bor shes par bya// dang po sems nyid gtan la 'bebs pa la// snang phyogs stong phyogs dbyer med gsum go dgos// snang ba sems kyi 'gyu ba phyi ru phyogs// stong pa rnam rtog rgyun 'gags phyam mer gnas// de gnyis rig pas dbyer med gcig tu bsdus// stong gsal ma 'gags rig pa'i snying po can// 'khor 'das gyes so gnyug ma'i rang zhal te// bskyang bya'i snying po yin pa dgongs par mdzod// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// rnam rtog lhan skyes chos sku'i rtsal shes pas// ma bcos so mar bzhag pas rtogs pa 'char// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin skyong na yang bskyar 'char// de la gegs dang gol sa la sogs pa// rnam rtog sbun po'i rjes 'brang mi bya bar// gang shar rig pa de ka'i snang thog tu// rtse gcig rbad gcod byed pa gnad du zab// tha mal snang zhen lha skur gsal ba dang*// bla mar mos gus ltem rkyang med pa ru// 'gro ba'i don du stong nyid snying rje sgoms// 'khor 'das dbyer med bsngo bas rgyas 'debs 'tshal// mdor na rgyal ba'i bka' dang grub pa'i lung*// bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho rnams// nyams su len bya'i gdams pa yin pa'i phyir// de kun las lhag smos su ci zhig yod// de skad zur mang bstan 'dzin mchog sprul gyi// bzhed skong ched du dpal spungs yang dben nas// si tu padma'i ming gis spel ba'i dges// sgrub brgyud bstan ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin gyur cig

/su dza ya// ༈ //don dam rang gsal ngo bo kun tu bzang*// ma 'gags sna tshogs rtog pa'i rol rtsed can// mkha' la sprin ltar 'gro 'ong dang bral ba// ka dag lhan skyes rdzogs pa che 'grub shog / rig 'dzin rnam rgyal ngor spel/// / ༈ dpal rigs kun khyab bdag dkyil 'khor gtso// mgon skyabs gnas mtshungs med karma pa// dus 'di bzung bla med snying po'i bar// 'bral med pa spyi bor rtag bzhugs gsol// sems gdod nas dag pa'i rang bzhin la// glo bur gyi ma rig 'khrul pa'i dri// rang shar dang rang grol ngang nyid du// blo 'das kyi brjod med don rtogs shog / ces pa'ang chos dgyes la spel/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ gzhi gdod nas rnam dag gnyug ma'i gshis// lhan skyes kyi rang byung ye shes ngang*// gang snang ba sna tshogs rten 'brel ba'i// chos nyid kun zad sar 'khyol gyur cig / karma bkra shis la spel/// / ༈ rang byung mtha' bral kun tu bzang po'i klong*// ye nas ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang rtsal gdangs// gzung 'dzin dang bral gsal stong bde ba che// byar med ngang la grol 'gyur e ma ho// sgrub pa rgyal byed la'o/// / ༈ dus gsum rnam par rtog pa'i chos thams cad// mkha' las sprin ldang slar yang mkhar thim bzhin// gang shar bzo med rig rtsal 'gags med ngang*// 'chi med chos sku'i rang zhal gnas mthong shog / sgrub theg 'phel la'o/// / ༈ na mo ratna gu ru/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// byin rlabs chen po'i 'od stong ldan// thugs rjes ma rig mun pa sel// nus mthus 'gro blo'i skyed tshal du// rnam dag dge ba'i rdzing bu bskyil// dri med yon tan pad dkar bkra// bsdu dngos bzhi yi yal gas btegs// yang dag dam pa'i bcud ster ba// skyabs dang mgon po bla na med// lo ki shwa ra karma ka /rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje yi// zhabs kyi padma tshe rabs su// 'bral med nyin byed dbang po bzhin// mos pa'i yid mkhar rtag tu 'char// sgrib gnyis smag rum drungs nas 'byin// tshogs gnyis ljon pa'i rtsa ba brtan// gzhan phan lo 'dab phyogs bcur g.yo// rang byung gnyug ma'i 'bras bu smin// ma rgan mkha' khyab 'tsho ba'i gzhi// sman mchog dam par bdag gyur cig

/kye ma/ ye nas 'khrul pa'i snang ba cher 'phel nas// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs zhags pas dam du bcings// thar med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal me 'obs kyi// btson dong 'di ru rang nyid rang gis khrid// de las thar bar 'dod ba'i blo skyes na// dkar po dge ba bcu yi them skas 'dzegs// chos kyi mchog gyur phyag chen nyams len bskyang*// rtag tu byang chub sems ni brjed mi bya// mos gus dad pa'i 'dun ma ma zhan par// 'chi chos rnam par dag pa'i blo chod na// bka' brgyud byin rlabs mi 'jug mi srid mod// 'on kyang rang rang nyon mongs stobs che bas// 'bad dang rtsol ba mi nus nyin re bzhin// ngag gi bzlas brjod yid kyis bskyed mi nus// 'di dag chu la ri mo bris pa'i dpe// 'bras med lags so des na khyod nyid kyis// thugs kyi gting nas phyi ma'i don gnyer na// dad gus dam tshig mi ldan rang dbang med// dper na skom pa chu la bsnyegs pa bzhin// gzhan nas rtsol sgrub dgos par mi snang ngo*// de skad sngon byon grub pa'i dbang po mchog /rgyal sras bla ma rnams kyi tshad ma'i gsung*// gsung rab rnams las dad pa skye dgos pa'i// zhal gdams snying por 'dug pas de bzhin mdzod//

ces pa'ang bsam gtan chos mchog gling gi kun spangs pa rtogs ldan karma kun dga'i ngor si tus bris/ maṅga lam*/// / ༈ bsod nams tshogs chen 'bras smin pas// dal brgyad 'byor ba bcu ldan pa'i// mi yi rten mchog deng 'dir thob// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam pa mjal// zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul gyis// rang rgyud sim pa'i skal bzang dang*// gzhan phan rlabs chen byang chub kyi// sems gnyis dag gis yongs bskul te// sngon byon grub pa'i rnam thar bskyang*// chos brgyad 'khri ba rgyab tu bor// mi rtog ye shes phyag rgya che'i// gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon gyur shog / ces wa ra'i sgrub chen nas bskul bzhin spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sngon goms byang chub kyi// spyad pa spyod zin na'ang thugs rje'i 'phrul// deng 'dir rgyal kun phrin las 'gro ba'i mgon// mngon par gsal gang kun tu rgyal gyur cig /mgon khyod tshe 'od dpag med rnam par rol// skyes rabs tshar dngar sa skyong ind+ra'i mtshan// nā ga rdzu na la sogs mkhas grub brnyes// rim byon zla bral thub mchog bstan gsal byed// khyad par sgrub brgyud ring lugs spel ba'i gnyen// gang 'dir gzhan phan gzugs skur ston pa nyid// bdag blo'i yid kyi padmo'i dga' tshal du// rdzogs ldan bskal bzang nam mkha'i nor bu bzhin// tshe rabs 'brel ba'i dam tshig btsan po yis// zab gsang rdo rje'i chos sgo ston pa la// res 'ga' slob dpon res 'ga' slob ma'i tshul// cir yang bsgyur ba phrin las dpag dka' zhing*// rgyal mchog karma'i nges don srol 'dzin pa// yin la yin par nges pa'i gna' bo'i lugs// bkur sti rje sa phul 'di don med min// 'on kyang bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam par thar// ji bzhin bla ma bsten pa'i thabs tshul yang*// nā ros tilli bsnyen pa'i dpe bzhin par// phyogs mtshungs dgongs don nges pa can 'bab pa'i// bka' nan che thang bstsal la yi rang zhing*// phyis 'byon mthon po'i go sar bzhugs pa rnams// chos phyir ji mi snyam gyi kun rtog ni// ches cher bdo bas rgyal bka' ras bor ba'i// spyod tshul go ldog kho nar skyong rnams kyang// ston par zhal 'ches tshul 'chos spel bzhin du// che dang snyan pa'i grags pas gdul bya rnams// 'dul ba'i spang blang las 'bras 'dir gzhig tshe// bcom ldan zhal nas gsungs pa dbang bzhag na// las de'i 'bras bu ci zhig myong gyur kye// dpal ldan karma'i thugs rjes bzung du gsol//

zhes tre ho zhabs drung rin po cher sngar thob kyi phyag len dang*/ khri gdan sogs bkur bzos zhus par/ kho bo la smin grol gsan bzhes rigs bdag bsten pa'i des na sngon byon grub pa'i rnam thar skyong ba thugs bzhed spro tshul phebs pa'i bka' len du phul ba'o/// / ༈ rang byung blo 'das chos sku'i rol pa las// bde chen longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// ma 'gags thugs rje'i rol rtsed sprul pa'i gar// sku gsum ngo bo bla mar gsol ba 'debs// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sgrib bral ba// gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon du rtogs par shog /gzhi dad dang dam tshig brtan po la// lam rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dge sdig gi// spang blang kun gces spras rnam kun du// yengs med dang sgom med gnyug ma'i gshis// sems chos sku'i rang zhal ma bcos ngang*// dran rdzi'i bya ra dang dbyer med par// chu bo'i rgyun rnal 'byor dbyer med kyis// nyin mtshan kun 'bral med nyams len 'tshal// dus nam zhig rang byung ye shes don// lhan skyes kyi rang ngo mngon gyur nges// de skad padma'i ming can gyis// dad dam ldan bzhed ngor spel dge'o// spre'u sprul skus bskul ltar bris pa bkra shis/// / ༈ swasti/ rang rig ye shes mngon sum ston mdzad pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin rlabs stsol// phyag rdzogs dbu gsum bzhed gzhung mang mod kyang*// bla slob so so'i rgyud tshod dang bstun pa'i// 'chad tshul mang yang 'gags don gcig las ci// 'on kyang dad brtson goms pas ma 'chun na// sla chos go ba tsam gyis gnad khel dben// stong gsal rig pa'i snying po can rtogs na// thog mtha' bar gsum gegs gol mi 'byung zhes// rgyal ba rgod tshang chen pos bzhed ltar la// stong zhes phyang chad tshogs drug bsgag pa dang*// stong par zhen pa'i las 'bras blang dor bral// snying rje byang sems spang sogs bdud las kyi// gegs la rnam kun dogs 'dzem shin tu gces// gsal ba la'ang dpyad pa mang gyur kyang*// blta bar sems pa'i ngo de mthong ma thag

/stong pa gshis yin rang gdangs gsal hrig ge// nyams la 'byung ba de nyid kho na las// gsal zhes sgra la dngos por 'dzin byas nas// blo yis bcos bsgyur mang po byed pa ni// rtog ge'i yul las nyams su len pa'i gegs// rig pa rjen pa mngon sum mthong ba ni// rtogs pa thob pa'i dus las mi 'byung yang*// phyogs mtshungs gsal nyams de ka sems nyid las// gzhan du med pa'i ngo bo shes thog glod// skad cig ma yi nyams de ma shor na// mnyam gzhag ming du btags shing nyams len mthil// slar yang shes pa yul du 'phro tsam la// skad cig gsum las mi 'gyang ngo shes bya// de ltar smos pa mdo don tsam du ste// zhib par nyams khrid sngon byon bka' brgyud kyi// rdo rje'i gsung la goms 'dris dpang por 'tshal// gang nyid skyes sbyangs ldan zhing dad dam gtsang*// rig 'dzin mchog gi brgyud par ldan gyur pas// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub mthar phyin nas// rnam kun bkra shis dge ba'i dpal ldan shog /dza yantu/// / ༈ dus gsum kun mkhyen karma par// gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin grol gyi// lam la 'god par byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// rang sems stong par gnas pa 'di// gang shar rnam rtog rjes mi 'brangs// da lta'i shes pa so ma yi// ngang la bcas bcos med par bzhag /sa le seng nge ye rer bzhag /de yang dran rdzi'i so pas bskul// yang yang bstar chags 'bad pa dang*// 'gro la snying rje skyabs gsum la// mos gus dam tshig dag gtsang gi /mthu yis phyag chen ye shes kyi// nyams myong rgyud la skye bar 'gyur// ces pa'ang rig 'dzin ngor spel/// / ༈ grub thob rgya mtsho'i gtso mchog thos pa dga'// gang der gsol 'debs byang chub bar du skyongs// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes rgyud thog 'dir// 'phral rkyen sgrib pas ma gos chos sku yi// ngo bo gnad du smin par byin gyis rlobs// snang srid dag pa chen po'i ngang nyid la// 'das pa'i rjes bcad spangs shing ma 'ongs pa'i// rnam rtog yid la mi 'phreng da lta yi// shes pa ma bcos so ma'i ngang der skyongs// de yang dran rdzi brtan po'i rtsi yis 'debs// mos gus dag snang sbyangs dang snying rje 'byongs// bar ma chad par snying rus brtson pa na// nam zhig don dam ye shes mngon du 'char// byang chub snying po'i go 'phang mchog thob gyur//

ces pa'ang karma phun tshogs ngor spel/// / ༈ snang srid chos sku'i rang bzhin la// rgyas btab rnal 'byor thos pa dga'// ras pa mchog des byang chub bar// mi 'bral rtag tu skyong gyur cig /bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ba// sems kyi don dam de kho na'i// gnas lugs gzhi dang lam 'bras bu// mthar phyin phyag rgya che rtogs shog sngon song rnam rtog gi rjes mi 'brang*/ rjes nas bsam blo 'phro mi 'jug da ltar gyi shes pa hrig ge ba'i ngang la yag tu re ba dang*/ nyes kyis dogs pa spangs te/ dran rdzi'i rgyang so btsugs la rgyun par nyams len ngo bo skyong ba'i mnyam bzhag rgya mtsho lta bu/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod lam gyis/ mthar thug bla med thob par 'gyur ro// sgom chen 'phags mchog ngor spel/// / ༈ don dam blo 'das sems nyid chos kyi sku// gdod nas rnam dag ma skyes 'dus ma byas// rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub de bzhin nyid// glo bur 'khrul ba'i dri mas ma bslad cing*// mi rtog zag med bde chen zhi ba'i ngang*// bsgom bya sgom byed rtsol ba rnams spangs nas// 'bad med nyid du ma bcos rang sar bzhag /brjod bral blo 'das rang byung ye shes ni// sku gsum dbyer med mchog gi ngo bo ste// bdud bzhi nyon mongs gnyis 'dzin g.yul ngo rnams// mthar byed yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpa' bo yin// bla med theg pa'i yang snying gdams pa'i gnad// skal bzang snying gi padmor rol par 'os// de skad dzam thang chos grwa yi// bslab gsum rim gnyis skal ldan pa// padma maṅga'i 'gro chos su// bskul phyir tā yi si tu pa// padma nyin mor byed pas smras// shu bham/// / ༈ kun bzang padma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por sems can rigs drug mkha' khyab la// byams dang snying rje tshad med bsgom pa dang*// bar du bla mar mos gus dag snang sbyangs// tha mar rang sems ma bcos so ma'i ngang*// sngon song rjes gcod ma 'ongs dran med ngang*// da lta'i shes pa de yi ngo bo blta// skabs su dran pa'i rgyang so yengs med kyis// yig drug bzla zhing dus gsum dge tshogs kun// rang dang 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir// bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa dang*// chung ngu'i dge sdig blang dor bag yod bya// de ltar skal bzang g.yar ngor si tus spel/// /

༈ thob dka'i dal 'byor ldan dus 'dir// sngon bsags bsod nams smin pa'i mthus// snying po'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// ma nor bla mas rjes bzung zhing*// skal ldan dad dang dam tshig gi// rtsa ba brtan cing las 'bras kyi// blang dor ji bzhin 'dor med dang*// slob dpon pha mar bkur sti sogs// chos dang 'jig rten mthun 'jug gis// byang chub sems la rtag gzhol zhing*// sgo gsum khyer so gsum ldan gyi// nyams len rgyas gdab mi 'bral 'tshal// zhes karma rgyal ba'i ngor spel/// / ༈ 'khor ba blos btang thar pa don gnyer ba'i// kun spangs padma mthar phyin deng nas bzung*// snang sems re dogs spros pa rgyang bskyur la// nam 'chi nges med tshe 'di rlung nang gi// mar me ji bzhin des na yang dag gi /lam bzang nges pa'i don la gnyer bar byos// dad dang dam tshig mos gus so nam gyis// byang chub chen po'i lo 'dab bskyed byas nas// ring min bla med 'bras bu spyod la nye// des na bgrang bya'i grangs 'dzin 'di bya dang*// 'di byed gtan 'dun chos brgyad ring spangs la// tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub la don gnyis po// mthar phyin mdzod cig padma mthar phyin pa// ces pa'ang si tus smras pa'o/// / ༈ sngar 'das rtog pa'i rjes mi bcad// ma 'ongs rnam rtog mdun mi bsu// da lta'i shes pa ngo bo dang*// ngos bzung bral ba de'i ngang zhog /rnam kun dran rdzi ma bral bar// mos gus snying rjes rgyud bskul nas// brtson pas nyams blangs rang rig gi// ye shes mngon du rtogs par 'gyur// ces pa'ang smras so/// / ༈ gdod ma'i mgon po kun khyab kun tu bzang*// dbyer med rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rjes skyongs// rang sems lhan skyes dri bral chos kyi sku// bde chen 'gyur med rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /de yang tha mal shes pa'i rnam rtog 'di// 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad cing ma 'ongs pa'i// 'di bya 'di byed dran rig mdun mi bsu// gang shar so ma de ngang mnyam par bzhag

/dus kun dran rdzi'i rtsi dang ma bral bar// mos gus dag snang snying rje tshul khrims bsrung*// chos kyi rtsa ba rab tu brtan gyur na// bla med byang chub ring min nyid thob nges// ces gnas mdo karma rang grol la spel/// / ༈ bka' brgyud grub pa'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes pa rang byung gi// rig pa'i ye shes bder gshegs snying po che// blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shog /dus gsum rtog pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// ma bcos so ma'i ngang du byar med pa// rjen ne lhod de 'bol le shigs se bzhag /ma yengs skyong ba chos kun 'dus pa'i mchog /gzhan yang 'dus byas dge rtsa gang 'grub dang*// khyad par 'dus ma byas pa'i sems ngo bo// skyong ba sangs rgyas kun gyi bgrod pa'i lam// mthar thug phyir na sgo gsum chig dril 'tshal// de skad karma dar rgyas skyabs che dbu mdzad pa/ mchan/ gang de yi// g.yar ngor si tus spel ba maṅga lam/// / ༈ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla mar gsol btab nas// rang sems ma bcos rang babs gnyug ma'i ngang*// mnyam rjes kun tu bskyang bas gnas lugs kyi// rang zhal mngon mthong tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'gyur// zur mang blo gros ngor si tus spel/// / ༈ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yid dang 'dres nges mthar// bla ma rang sems dbyer med phyag rgya che// bya rtsol las 'das rang babs chu rgyun ltar// rtag par chad med sbyong ba'i nyams len 'tshal// go chen karma blo gros ngor spel/// / ༈ karma byang chub rtag par dkon mchog la// skyabs song smon 'jug byang sems bslab pa srungs// bskyed rdzogs mos gus phyag rgya cher 'dril bas// tshe gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par shog / ces pa'ang dad ldan ngor spel/// / ༈ spyi bor bzhi rdzogs gdan steng drin chen rje// rdo rje 'chang dbang dkon mchog kun 'dus gsal// snying nas gsol btab rang la thim pa'i mthar// bla ma rang sems dbyer med mnyam par bzhag

/ karma rang grol ngor spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog dwags rgyud gral na sangs rgyas kyi// rang zhal mngon gsal zhwa nag cod pan can// karma pa zhes skyob pa mtshungs bral des// tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /de ltar gsol thob sbyin sogs dge ba'i chos// rtag tu lhag pa'i bsam pas bsgrub par mdzod// sgrol ma lha mtsho'i ngor spel/// / ༈ karma chos 'dzin chos la dbang thob pa'i// gnas tshul yi ger bsrings der brtag pas na// gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel ba'i sgom pa zhes// bka' brgyud gsung mtshungs de ltar rgyun skyong 'tshal// zhes pa'ang dad pa'i ngor spel/// / ༈ swasti/ sngon sbyangs las 'phros 'bras bzang dus smin pas// grub rigs bstan 'dzin mchog tu lhun grub cing*// nges don gnas la nyams bzhes mthar phyin pa'i// bka' brgyud rnam thar skyong khyod 'tsho gyur cig /gang gi zab don thugs dam skyong tshul gyi// rtogs pa'i 'char sgo de tshul 'khrul med du// snang bas gsal gdab dgos pa dben mod kyang// gnas 'gyu bar lag 'gyel ba nyams myong mthil// rtogs grol dus mnyam rtogs pa mthar thug bzhed// bka' las 'byung bzhin mnyam bzhag nam mkha' ltar// skyong skabs yid dpyod mtha' dag rgyang bsring gnad// rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i byang sems sbyongs// de yang rig rtsal ngang du ro gcig par// lta ba 'khor 'das mnyam nyid klong zla'o// grub thob gong ma'i do ha las// phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba// chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems// phyi rol don mthong 'khrul pa'i blo// rmi lam bzhin te ngo bos stong*// chu bo rgyun 'babs lta bur sgom// de skad si tu par grags pa// snyom las padma'i ming can gyis// slob ma'i thu bor bsngags pa yi// mtsho sprul bzhed ngor spel dge'o/// / ༈ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa// dus snyigs mar lhag pa'i thugs rje can// dus rnam kun mkhyen pa o rgyan rje// dus 'dir dgongs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rang rig pa'i ngo bo lhan skyes kyi// gzhi gdod nas grub pa'i sems nyid 'di// 'phral ma dag 'khrul pa kun sangs nas// don bde chen ye shes 'char gyur cig

/so thar dang byang sems gsang ba sngags// dam tshig gi nyes ltung phra rags pa// spang blang rnams ji bzhin ma rtogs pa'i// nyes byas kun bshags so dag tshangs stsol// tshe mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe bstan bzhin// ther zug gi a 'thas snying pos dben// dus phyi mar bsam pa'i blo long med// rgyud bskul gyi chos la 'jug par shog /'khor 'das kun rang sems las byung ba// 'khor ba yi rtsa ba ma rig pa// bdag 'dzin gyi zhen pa rgyang bsring nas// bdag med kyi gnad gsang mthong gyur cig /sems dus gsum rtog pa'i 'phro bcad la// gang shar gyi ngo bor gcer gyis blta// gsal stong dang bde stong dbyer med par// byar med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de brjed med spyod lam rnam pa bzhir// ma yengs tsam dran pa'i rtsis zin bzhin// sgo gsum gyi dge las mtha' dag 'bad// dus nam zhig rang sems rjen par mthong*// gzhi bde gshegs snying po chos kyi sku// don 'bad rtsol bral ba phyag rdzogs kyi// bka' chig dril don gyi rtsa ba ste// de kun gyi gzhi rten bla ma la// mos gus dang dag snang sbyong ba gnad// 'khor chos la zhen log gzung 'dzin gyi// rnam rtog gi drwa bar ma 'thums par// rje bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar skyong bar smon// de skad skyabs sgar byang 'dren pa// dar rgyas gang nas kho bo la// bong bar gser mthong 'dun pa yis// bskul ngor gdams pa'i tshul du smras// dge'o/// / ༈ gzhi rnam bar dag pa'i zhing sa la// lam dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun rtag 'bebs pas// 'bras sku bzhi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// lus gzung 'dzin phra rags rtsa yi mdud// sku bde chen dbu ma'i ngo bor khrol// ngag smra brjod rtsol bcas ming dang tshig /gsung brjod med nā da'i rang sgrar bsgyur// yid 'gyu ba chags sdang rtog pa'i tshogs// thugs mi rtog ye shes dbyings su bstim// thugs rje la 'gags pa ma mchis shing*// gdul bya la nye ring mi mnga' bas// rje khyed kyi gsang gsum ye shes dang*// mi bdag gi lus ngag yid dang gsum// dbyer med pa lcags la gser 'gyur bzhin// dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs// dus nam zhig 'dus byas dor ba'i tshe// sham bha la rigs ldan zhing mchog der// dus skad cig 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs//

ces si tu padma'i ming can gyis/ rag shul be hu'i drung yig dge slong skal bzang nor bu'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ gangs can grub ba'i gtsug rgyan thos pa dga'// 'bral med spyi bo'i gtsug dang snying gi dkyil// bzhugs nas lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po yi// gzhi lam 'bras gsum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gang khyod sngon smon bzang po'i 'brel ba yis// dal rten mchog thob rtogs ldan bla ma mjal// rjes bzung smin cing grol ba'i lam zhugs nas// sems don nyams len de tshul skyong bzhin par// re dogs blang dor bral ngang brtson 'grus dang*// dad dam snying rje sems bskyed rnam dag gis// gzhir bzung chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la// 'bad pas don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par nges// dad gsum ldan pa rtogs ldan rnam dag bzhed ngor dge// / ༈ gsol 'debs nyams dbyangs su drangs pa'i skor bzhugs/ 'dir snang kun rdzob sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor la// gnas yul bdag tu 'dzin nas yang 'khrul ba'i// dug gsum nyon mongs rtsa ba rab brtan cing*// mi dge'i rnam rtog 'gyu pa'i rkang 'thung rgyas// bag med dbang gyur spyod pa'i lo 'dab ldan// sgrib gnyis yongs 'du'i ljon pa bdag lta ni// sngon tshe bsod nams byang chub 'bras smin pas// sangs rgyas dngos snang sangs rgyas lung zin pa// rgyal dbang karma pa dang zhwa dmar pa// thugs kyi rdo rje nyi ma'i mtshan can dang*// 'chi med dpal dar la sogs zhabs bsnyen pa'i// kun rdzob mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'brel dang*// don dam 'gyur med dkyil 'khor chen po yi// smin grol ye shes byin rlabs 'pho dbang thob// rgyal rnams thugs rje'i 'jug pa ring min yang*// rang rgyud las nyon chu klung bzlog dka' bas// de slad grol lam tshad du phyin ma nus// log rtog khor mo yug tu bskyed bsring ngang*// mgon rnams bdag sogs 'gro rgyud le lo can// bskul phyir mi mngon dag pa'i zhing khams su// sku gsum lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi ngang*// thim pa'i snang ba bstan 'di kye ma hud// 'on kyang rang byung gdod ma'i sems nyid dang*// dbyer med bla ma gcig 'dres nges shes kyi// snying gi ti lar rtag tu mchod byed na// bdag sogs 'khor ba'i duḥkha bsgral du gsol// sems nyid chos sku'i rang zhal bstan du gsol// gsang gsum byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang mchog stsol// mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// yang ye da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa yi// tshad thub rgyal ba'i lung gis bsngags 'os pa// gangs can 'dir yang nyi mo'i skar ma tsam// chos brgyad bslu brid 'dod yon sred pa dang*// snyan pa la sogs sgrub 'dod tshul 'chos kyi// gang zag che dgu stobs 'byor dpal grags can// yid srubs rnams kyis phrin las phyogs mthar spel// 'brel tshad gol ba'i lam ston chen po yi// go sa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen sa steng khyab// de 'dra'i bskal dus 'char ba'i dus 'dir ni// bdag blo'i mos pas yar gzhal ma yin pa// grub pa'i sar gnas grub pa rnams kyis ni// e ma ngo mtshar yon tan rab brjod cing*// nges don snying po'i ring lugs rgyal mtshan gang*// bsgreng bar mnga' gsol rdo rje can mchog de// rdo rje slob dpon dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs// 'dren pa bse ru lta bu gang las su// mig stong ldan pas dpyad kyang rnyed byar min// des na gang khyod bdag sogs bsod nams kyi// zhing mchog 'di ru bskal pa bskal pa'i bar// g.yo med rtag par bzhugs gsol rdo rje gsum// 'pho 'gyur bri gang gdod nas gtan bral yang*// gnyis snang ngo 'dir mi shigs dwangs ma'i sku// tshe 'od mgon bzhin bzhugs par gsol 'debs na// 'jig rten 'dir snang zhen pa rgyang bsring nas// bla med de kho na yi gnas lugs don// gnyug ma'i ye shes rang byung rig pa'i mdangs// byar med blo 'das chos kun ye dag pa'i// kun khyab kun byed rgyal po kun tu bzang*// mchog gi go 'phang deng 'dir lhun grub shog

/ ces pa'ang mchog rnams thugs rje rjes dran gyi gsol ba btab pa'o/// / ༈ bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i thugs rje bskul dbyangs byin rlabs sprin phung zhes pa bzhugs/ na mo gu ru padmā kā ra ya/ dpal rigs kun bdag po bcom ldan 'das// mchog kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan sku// rdo rje 'chang dngos su snang ba can// rje bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud// rtsod ldan gyi snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i// dus bskal pa'i rang mdangs ngom pa'i mthus// bslu chos dang smon lam gol ba yi// phyi ltar snang bzang po'i ngang tshul can// rgyal khams kun 'gengs shing bstan pa spel// chos grub mthar tha snyad nga rgyal rlom// ris mthun gyi che dgus skyabs su bsten// 'phral blo sna chos la bsgyur ro skad// phug smon 'brel gyi thar pa'i lam dogs nas// yang srid kyi gnas ngan khor mo yug /tshul de 'dra'i g.yang sar ma lhung ba'i// skal ldan rnams las kyi 'phro ldan snyam// sngon sangs rgyas gyi drang nges zab mo'i don// tshul ji bzhin rtogs pa'i gdeng thob pa'i// rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam las 'das// bka' brgyud pa che bzhi chung brgyad dang*// khyad par du 'phags pa sgrub pa'i brgyud// don nges pa karma kaṃ tshang gi /chos brgyud pa'i ring lugs gral chud 'di// sngon dkar po dge ba'i sa bon smin// thob dka' ba'i dal 'byor phun tshogs ldan// mjal dka' ba'i mtshan ldan rin po che// mthing dbang gi cod pan 'chang zhabs bsnyen// dpal 'jig rten dbang dang 'od dpag med// mchog gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin ni// rgyal shāka thub padma 'byung sogs kyis// mdo sngags rgyud kun tu gsal bar bstan// rje sangs rgyas dngos snang rang gzugs kyi// sku dkyil 'khor mjal zhing gsung bdud rtsi// thugs ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs thob// skal can las skal ba ldan par byas// gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i yang rtse mchog

/dpal nā ro mai tri'i bzhed pa'i gzhung*// chos zab mo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzang po// rje mnga' bdag lo tsā chen po des// blo gros kyi bum par gtams pa yi// lam mthar thug don gyi brgyud pa mchog /rje ras pa chen po nas bzung ste// bdud 'dul ba'i rdo rje'i bar byon pa'i// grub brnyes kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad// chos brgyud pa nye ring bsgrang ma dgos// skal ldan kun dad brtson shes rab kyi// sems mos gus zhen log nges 'byung blos// byams snying rje tshad med mkha' khyab kyi// 'gro ba kun rnam grol sar bkod pa'i// dmigs med kyi ngang du nyams len skyongs// rang dbang la rang gi yod dus 'dir// chos brgyad las blo bsgyur dben sa bzung*// dam tshig la gces spras 'du 'dzi spangs// nyams len gyis sa bon thebs gyur na// dus nam zhig 'dus byas yal ba'i tshe// chos dbyings kyi mkha' khyab yangs pa ru// bde chen gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku thob// 'gags med kyi sprul bsgyur ston nus pa// bka' zab mo'i byin brlabs drin re che// las nyon mongs drag po'i rlung shugs kyis// zad med kyi rnam g.yeng chu ris ltar// 'khor ba ru yang 'khor bdag 'dzin dbang*// yid byed kyi cho 'phrul dwangs dus med// rje rgyal ba'i thugs rje yol min kyang*// rtag 'dzin gyi rnyed bkur bdud bzhi yi// khri mun gyi dpung gis non lags na// mchog byin rlabs 'od snang bstan du gsol// lus ngag yid nyon mongs dbang gyur na// gnyen po rgyud thog tu khel bar byin gyis rlobs// rten 'brel kun lus la 'grig par byin gyis rlobs// nyams rtogs pa sems la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// 'gro don phyogs med du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sa lam gyi yon tan 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi yi rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs// bsam don kun lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//

ces pa'ang sgrub sde'i bla ma kun spangs pa ā nanta bha dras gser gyi maṇḍal bcas 'di ltar bskul ngor/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos sa zla'i dkar phyogs gang ba'i dus dge bar spel/ maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/// / ༈ gsol 'debs ngag gi gling bu mchog thun siddhi'i gru char bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos// drin chen rdo rje 'chang dbang*// rje btsun bdu~Xd 'du~Xl rdo~X rje~X// snying gi thig ler rtag bzhugs// kye ma snyigs dus mun pa// drwa bas 'brel ba'i dus 'dir// log rtog hu lu'i 'gro rnams// nyon mongs las kyi ser bus// thar med g.yang sar ltung dus// pad 'byung thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings// brtse chen khyung sngon skyes kyis// drangs pa'i 'jig rten mig gcig /skye dgu'i 'dren pa zla med// thub bstan rin chen gsal byed// bdu~Xd tshogs 'du~Xl ba'i rdo~X rje~X// nyin byed 'od stong gsal zhing*// dmu rgod gdul dka'i sa gzhir// rjes 'dzin chu khur phreng ba// cho~Xs rgyal gru~Xb pa rgya~X mtsho~X'i// sgyu ma'i gar gyi brda bstan// phrin las bzang pos mkha' khyab// thar lam myu gu bskyed pa'i// cho~Xs kyi~X char gyi sna~Xng bas// dam pa'i bdud rtsis bsil byin// zab lam padmo'i dga' tshal// mchog gi 'byung gnas dam pa// shrī~X tsi~Xtta~X ba~Xdzra~X// rdo rje theg pa'i lo 'dab// phyogs bcur spro ba'i dpa~Xl ldan// sgrub brgyud bstan pa da~Xr rgyas// mtha' yas yon tan rgya mtsho'i// dba~Xng phyug mchog gi~X rdo~X rje~X// bsta~Xn 'dzi~Xn rin chen gling du// dgos 'byung cho~Xs kyi~X nor bu// nyi~X ma~X'i 'od zer ji bzhin// 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur// bdag sogs srid pa'i sems can// mu med rdul gyi grangs 'das// byang chub lam la dkri ba'i// mgon rnams thugs rje ma g.yel// bcos min gdung shugs drag pos// sgo gsum rtse gcig phyag 'tshal// rab 'byams dpag par dka' ba'i// mchod sprin rgya chen 'bul lo// dug lngar gyur pa'i 'khrul nongs// spang blang 'gal ba bshags so// bder gshegs mdzad pa mthar phyin// gzhan phan spyod la yi rangs// zhing gi 'dren pa mchog rnams// dam chos ston par gsol lo// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed kun// grangs med bskal par bzhugs 'tshal// bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i// rab dkar dge tshogs ji snyed// thams cad byang grol chen po'i// rgyu ru bsngo bar bgyi'o// 'dzam gling lha yi lhar gyur// 'phags mchog lo~X ka~X nā~X tha~X// gnyis med karma pa yi// phrin las chu shel dbang po// dri med 'od dkar snang bas// skal ldan gdul bya'i ku muta// ches cher spro bar mdzod cig

/'og min zhing gi bdag po'i// zhabs drung myur bar 'khod pa'i// ston ka'i zla 'dra'i dpal mnga'// thugs rje bsil ba'i lcags kyus// rten thog 'di ru drongs shig /bdag dang 'brel thogs sems can// kaṃ tshang nges don snying po'i// dam pa'i lam srol bzang po// phyag rgya chen po mchog gi// gnas lugs ngo bo'i don rtogs// sku bzhi mngon du gyur nas// rigs drug dong nas sprugs pa'i// 'dren pa'i dpal du gyur cig /kye ma las ngan bdag sogs// gnyis 'dzin re dogs dbang gis// 'dus byas chu yi lbu ba// mi rtag pha rol gyur tshe// gzhi lam 'od gsal 'dres nas// chos sku mtha' bral sangs rgyas// bar dor sgra dang 'od zer// zhi dang khro bo'i lha tshogs// 'char tshe rang ngo zin cing*// gnyis med longs skur gyur cig /srid pa bar do'i 'du 'phrod// chags sdang rnam par shar dus// dag snang phyogs med 'byongs nas// skye ba sprul pa'i sku yis// 'gro ba'i don chen spyod pa'i// mgon khyod thugs rje ma g.yel// mthar thug byang chub snying po// de ma thob kyi bar du// bdag ni skye zhing skye bar// dpa~Xl lda~Xn sgrub brgyud snying po'i// 'gyu~Xr me~Xd bsta~Xn pa'i sgor zhugs// 'dzi~Xn skyong phyo~Xgs la~Xs rna~Xm gro~Xl// pa~Xdma~X nyi~Xn mor bye~Xd bzhin// khams dang dba~Xng po~X'i rim par// sde bzhi'i dge tshogs spel zhing*// rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma'i// phrin las shing rtar gyur nas// thub mchog ston pa gnyis pa'i// ring lugs 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir// rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan// mi nub srid rtser bsgreng ba'i// rab rgyas phun tshogs gyur cig /tshul 'dir sdang pa'i blo can// log par zhugs pa'i nyams pa// zhing bcu tshang ba'i duṣṭan// snying rje'i stobs kyis bsgral phyir// bdag gis thal bar brlag pa'i// drag po chen po'i mthu rtsal// rdzu 'phrul nus pa'i gzi yis// rgyal bstan skyong bar gyur cig

/gzhan yang dwags brgyud bstan par// bsnyen dang bkur sti sri zhur// brtson pas dang len nus pa'i// 'khor los sgyur dang rgyal phran// ma nges so sor ston cing*// mnga' ris dge bcu'i khrims kyi// bde legs dpal 'byor ldan pas// rdzogs ldan lta bur spyod cig /mdor na yid lus rten 'di// nyam thag mgon med rnams kyi// gdung sel 'dod pa 'jo ba'i// yid bzhin re skong shog cig /de ltar smon lam rgya mtsho// bsod nams mtha' yas zab mo'i// dge las byung ba'i rin chen// don gnyis gling du bgrod kun// dal 'byor gru la brten nas// sems bskyed skya bas bskul zhing*// yid srubs las rlung la sogs// mi mthun rigs las grol te// theg mchog ma~X ṇi ra~Xtna// dngos grub gser gyi bum bzang*// dpyod ldan mos pa'i don bzhin// yongs su thob par gyur cig /'di ko skal bzang bung ba'i// gdung shugs drag po'i glu dbyangs// gsol ba'i snying po'i gnas na// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i skyed tshal// skyabs gsum padma dkar po// rmad byung 'dab stong rgyas 'dra'i// phul byung rtsi bcud rol phyir// mchog gsum dam pa'i ngo bo// dhi~X pāṃ~X ma~X hā~X sa~X twa~X// gu~X ru~X dha~Xrma~X ra~X dza~X// 'og min zhing gi bdag po// shrī~X ba~Xdzra~X dha~X ra~X// bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med// rab 'byams dpa' bo'i dbang po// bde ba mchog gi 'khor lo// yum gyur rdo rje btsun mo// chos dbyings rtsal las grub pa'i// he ru ka dpal khro chen// gcig bsdus ma hā kā la// ber nag lcam dral la sogs// khyod rnams 'das dang da lta// ma 'ongs dus gsum gzigs shing*// grag stong gsung gi bden tshig /rdzu 'phrul nus pa'i mthu ldan// gang zhig ji ltar gsol ba'i// smon lam byams pa'i sprin phung*// thugs bskyed lha lam ngogs nas// mthun 'gyur dbyar gyi rnga chen// mos ldan gtsug phud can gyi// dad pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ro// zhen log 'khor ba'i 'dam nas// brgal te bde chen bgrod do// 'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs// sa mu dra yi rang bzhin// rnam dag chu bo'i rgyun bzang*// lus can pad tshal bskyed bsring*// dwags brgyud nam mkha'i nor bu// nges gsang snying po'i 'od stong*// mtha' klas zhing khams rgya mtshor// yongs su khyab par gyur cig

/swasti/ rgyal bstan bstan 'dzin 'dzin pa'i nor bu// dpal mgon mgon skyabs skyabs gyur dam pa// bcom ldan zhi ba chags bral tshogs mchog /mchog gsum phyag 'tshal bde legs shog cig /thugs rje'i gter chen rigs kun khyab bdag karma ka /thugs rje'i rang gzugs rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum// bstan srung thugs rje'i mthu ldan ber nag lcam dral tshogs// rtsa gsum thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bde legs shog /

ces gtan gyi 'dun ma'i re ltos bslu ba med pa gcig chog tu nges shing*/ de yang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi grub brnyes tshad ma'i brgyud pa dang ldan pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang zhes nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa nges don snying po don gyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i dpal mgon sems dpa' chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba dpal karma pa dang gar dbang mi yi zol can na rim 'di dag /bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i tog dang rgyal dbang padma kā ra sogs kyi lung gis zin pa'i rgyal tshab dam par bsngags pa 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa chen po rje btsun karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje gtso bor gyur ba'i zhal mjal chos kyi bdud rtsi thob pa rnams kyi drung du yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo gsum mi phyed gdung shugs drag pos rgyud bskul te rang blor ji tsam dpag pa'i smon lam gyi tshul du smras pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i phung po ji snyed kyi mthu la brten nas/ rgyal bstan rin po che dar rgyas dang*/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can yongs la bsngo zhing*/ kun kyang byang chen myur thob kyi rgyur gyur cig /ces phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mu med mtha' yas par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad ba'i phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu dang ldan pa rnams kyis ji bzhin smon pa thams cad de bzhin yongs su 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar dad pa'i mos blos kun nas bslangs te rang bzhin tho ler brjod pa'i smon lam 'di/ me 'brug gnam lo rgyal por spyod cing*/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud rgyal gyi dgongs par dpyid zla 'bring po sgrol byed phālku naḥnya pa'i tshes brgyad gza' yi dbang phyug rau hi ṇi yaḥ

mdun du btsun mo mṛ ga shīrṣaṃ dga' bzhed rtsed 'jos brel ba'i dkar phyogs bzang por mdo khams 'bri klung gser ldan kyi char gtogs pa'i byang a ta rong dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sa spyod dpal spungs dpal gyi gnas mchog gi gtsug lag khang thub bstan chos 'khor gling zhes pa'i bslab ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus nas skal ldan dad pa'i blo can padma nyin byed dbang pos gsol ba btab pa 'bras smin lhun grub tu gyur cig / asmartu dza ti sarbā shuddhaṃ bā tsā pa raṃ pa rā bai sa mya/ karmā ka shaiṣṭa bai ga hya dza ṭa tu maṇṭi hi bha wantu shrī man/ shrī dzwa la dzambu dī ba maṅga la bha wantu/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dpal dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa// mgon snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon chos kyi rje// bdud 'dul ba'i rdo rje 'chang ba po// khyed mi mngon dag pa'i dbyings nas dgongs// bdag mos pa'i bu la rjes brtse ba'i// thugs chos dbyings mi zad rol pa las// deng mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char// rgyud byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bsdu na de tsam dang spro na/ snyigs ma las snyigs ma'i bskal pa 'dir// bdag dred po chos med rgyud mi 'chos// bzang brdzus kyi mgo bskor rnam g.yeng can// thugs rje yis gzigs pa'i mthu ma chung*// dpal bka' brgyud gong ma'i gshegs pa'i shul// gnas gtsug lag dang dge 'dun sde tshogs kyi// bsti gnas mchog sa spyod karma yi// snying po yi bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun// zhabs brtan cing phrin las rgyas pa dang*// bdag dang ni bdag 'dra'i gdul bya kun// tshe 'dir snang bsod nams dpal rgyas shing*// chos sgrub la phyogs pa'i 'dun pa rnams// gegs med par 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// skye med kyi chos sku'i rang rtsal las// 'gag med kyi longs sku'i sgyu 'phrul shar// gnas med kyi sprul sku mchog thob nas// sku gsum gyi go 'phang yongs thob shog

/mgon thugs rje chen po'i stobs zab mo// rgyal gzhan las lhag pa'i sems dpa' yi// snying rje dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid can// 'gro drug la bu gcig ma yi tshul// skyabs skyob pa ma g.yel lha yi lha// rje ma 'ongs bskal bzang drug pa mchog /seng ge sgra zhes byar 'tshang rgya ba'i// deng gtan du 'bral med tshe rabs kun// mgon thugs rjes gzigs shig karma ka /bdud 'dul ba'i rdo rje dus 'dir dran// ces pa 'di karma dgon gyi bla ma sprul sku ba'i bzhed ngor spel/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
